findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_data_status · Public sink: submit_agent_trade_idea · Destructive: run_quant_simulation, analyze_stock_ai.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_data_status · Public sink: submit_agent_trade_idea · Destructive: run_quant_simulation, analyze_stock_ai

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get real-time verified stock price, 52-week range, PE ratio, volume, and market cap for any ticker symbol (Price: $0.01 USDC via x402 pay-per-call on Base)." → after: "Current stock price, 24h change and volume for a ticker (US, Hong Kong, India). Unknown tickers return a free 404. $0.01."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
